headline: The government appealed the September 14, 2026 order on the fixed admission period rule
plain: On September 30, 2026, the defendants filed a notice of appeal (ECF 53) from the memorandum and order of September 14, 2026 (ECF 50) in Presidents' Alliance on Higher Education and Immigration v. United States Department of Homeland Security, No. 1:26-cv-13799 (D. Mass.). The First Circuit case number is 26-2112. The order of September 14, 2026 (ECF 51) postponed the effective date of the final rule of July 17, 2026 (FR Doc. 2026-14439) and enjoined the defendants from implementing it, pending further order of the court or a decision on the merits. That final rule would change the admission period in the F, J, and I classifications from duration of status to an admission for a fixed time period. The district court docket listing fetched on October 2, 2026 shows no entry that stays that order. The First Circuit docket was not read.

claims.text: The final rule of July 17, 2026 (FR Doc. 2026-14439) would change the admission period in the F, J, and I classifications from duration of status to an admission for a fixed time period. The order of September 14, 2026 (ECF 51) enjoins its implementation.
